# The whole dEQP-GLES3 tree for the Verdin i.MX8M Plus in 133 table entries (one CONFIG_DEQP_CASE_TABLE entry per line; the selector i runs line i, counting from 0), DEQP_MODULE=gles3.
# Limit of the deqp sample (src/main.cpp case_argument): one entry is at most 2035 characters (arg[2048]), the selector index is masked to 8 bits (at most 256 entries). The longest entry here is 1868.
# Generated by tools/cts/imx8mp-gles3-gen.py from tools/cts/gles3-mustpass.txt (42810 cases); every mustpass case is matched by exactly one entry (tools/cts/check-imx8mp-gles3-tree.py). The filters match dEQP's whole tree; the tally restricts to the mustpass where it is given one.
# Sizing: an image's WDOG1 window is 600 s (boards/verdin_imx8mp_mimx8ml8_a53.conf), so an entry holds at most 1000 shader cases (random 600), 800 of the API groups, 400-600 ubo/fbo/fragment_out/fragment_ops, 300 transform_feedback, 150 texture, and 20 texture.filtering.3d (19-25 s a case on the AM62P: 1r ran it in images of 22 cases), 30 texture.size, 40 texture.format, 80 texture.shadow (AM62P 1r: 2,000 per image for shaders; the GC7000UL's GLES2 texture groups ran 36-192 cases an entry).
# To build: DEQP_MODULE=gles3 tools/cts/imx8mp-deqp-build.sh <name> 'dEQP-GLES3.info.*' --table tools/cts/imx8mp-gles3-tree.txt (docs/es3/board-recipe-imx8mp.md).
